verdict.rationale: An online government filing service could plausibly offer an API or automatable channel, so the axis applies. The evidence shows the opposite: there is no OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), formation runs on fillable PDFs submitted by upload, fax or mail, and the only mandatory online filing sits behind an image CAPTCHA anti-bot gate. Nothing documents a headless or CI-capable path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
